name: Exterior Vinyl Siding RP Surface Preparation
intent: Warranty gate, LRV verification, pressure wash, chalk test (QT3), scuff sand for adhesion, caulk assessment (QT3).
doctrine: Vinyl siding prep. Warranty void acknowledgment is first gate (client must sign off — painting voids manufacturer warranty). LRV verification: <35 = HARD STOP. Pressure wash with alkaline cleaner. Scuff sand smooth PVC for adhesion. No DSD, no RRP, no stain-blocking. Dramatically simpler than wood siding RP.
